name: memory-rsi
description: Git-backed markdown memory for Claude Code through the agent-memory CLI: progressive-disclosure skill, recall/save/setup commands, and opt-in lifecycle hooks (all off by default).

memory_base.title: Memory base
memory_base.description: Absolute path of the memory root the hooks read and write. Empty falls back to MEMORY_BASE, then AGENT_MEMORY_PATH; with none of them set every hook stays off.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Identity the hooks write and search as (exported as AGENT_ID). Empty keeps the AGENT_ID already in the environment.

hook_restore.title: Restore after compaction
hook_restore.description: After a compaction, read recent compaction snapshots and active efforts from the memory base plus files edited from the transcript, and inject a short summary into the new context. Writes no entries.

hook_precompact.title: Save before compaction
hook_precompact.description: Before a compaction, write one archived snapshot entry (recent requests, decisions, files edited, errors, commands from the transcript) under <agent>/efforts/_archive with no Git commit, then start a background claude -p --model haiku run that may file curated entries.

hook_subagent_load.title: Load memory into subagents
hook_subagent_load.description: When a subagent starts, search the memory base for its agent type, lessons and active efforts, ask claude -p (haiku, then sonnet; only when ~/.local/bin/claude exists) to assemble a briefing from memory, skills and rules, and inject the result into the subagent's context. Writes no entries.

hook_subagent_save.title: Save subagent results
hook_subagent_save.description: When a subagent stops, write one archived entry (its task, decisions, files edited, errors and final result from its transcript) under <agent>/efforts/_archive with no Git commit.

hook_policy.title: Inject editable policy
hook_policy.description: At every session start, resume, clear and compaction, read the editable memory policy (memory policy read) and inject its text into the context. Writes no entries.
